title: Rate Card Trim Line Items: Conditioning Charge for Cleaning and Damage Fees Work Orders
content:
1. The leather conditioning charge of a Wayfare partner work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report is read from the reported trip's ride option: Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV, whose cabins are leather, take the leather conditioning charge; Wayfare Comfort takes the cloth conditioning charge; any other ride option takes no conditioning charge.
2. The leather conditioning charge is $30.00 and the cloth conditioning charge is $15.00.
3. The ride option is the one on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) for the trip the report is on.
4. The conditioning charge is a fixed amount added to the work order's price; it does not depend on the seats requested or on the incident.

| Ride option on the trip record | Cabin | Conditioning charge |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black | leather | $30.00 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | leather | $30.00 |
| Wayfare Comfort | cloth | $15.00 |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green or Wayfare XL | — | none |
